name: Solar Guardian cuts stun duration on the Sun Cleric by 20% (#502)
contract: Solar Guardian 704581 (SpellFamilyName 33) carries two effects: effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (4, EffectMiscValue 5, EffectBasePoints -26 -> real -25) with no matching handler anywhere in this repo, an inert leftover the quoted tooltip does not describe. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232, comment in SpellAuraEffects.cpp: 'implement in Unit::CalculateSpellDuration') with EffectMiscValue 12 (MECHANIC_STUN) and EffectBasePoints -21, resolving to -20 with DieSides 1 -- exactly the tooltip's 'by 20%'. Unit::ModSpellDuration consumes this natively: inside its 'if (!positive)' branch (cut duration only of negative effects), for every mechanic bit the incoming spell carries it takes target->GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, MECHANIC_STUN) and AddPct(duration, durationMod); 'target' is the unit receiving the aura, matching the tooltip's 'on you'. The fixture debuff is the generic 'Stun' spell 46441 (Mechanic 12, effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN, EffectImplicitTargetA_1 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms flat, no per-level scaling): a self-cast stun is always negative (SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN auras are never positive), so Unit::ModSpellDuration reaches the mechanic-duration branch on the self-cast the same way it would on an enemy's stun. 2000 ms becomes 1600 ms with the talent. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control stuns itself with the fixture spell
The Solar Guardian talent stuns itself with the same fixture spell
The stun lands on the control
The stun lands on the talented Sun Cleric
Without the talent the stun keeps its full 2 second duration
With Solar Guardian the same stun is cut by 20% to 1.6 seconds
